title: Apple Watch Bugged Forever
text:
Wrote this review in early 2026. Updating to say it is still bugged in November 2026. 
The app is pretty good overall for tracking fitness progress. I only use the free version because it has not proved itself to be consistent nor reliable when it comes to my Apple Watch syncing with my phone. Every time I use my watch to progress the current exercise or change the weight or reps, it jumps to the next exercise. That, in turn, forces me to take my phone out again, fix the previous exercise and go back to the current one. Tedious and continuously broken since I started using the app a year ago. I will happily give you money for a lifetime subscription if you fix this.
